highlights.en: Played on 6 days (none on Wed): 154 rounds in all, 97 quiz and 57 practice, 24 more than last week.
highlights.zh: 今個星期有 6 日玩（星期三冇玩），總共 154 局：答題 97 局、練習 57 局，比上星期多 24 局。

highlights.en: Quiz games right first time 74% (last week 69%, about the same); practice games done smoothly 74% (last week 66%, about the same).
highlights.zh: 答題遊戲第一次答啱 74%（上星期 69%，差唔多）；練習遊戲做得順 74%（上星期 66%，差唔多）。

highlights.en: Steadiest: "Match the shadow" (right first time in all 9); still learning "Count the vehicles": 6 of 14 right first time.
highlights.zh: 最穩陣係「邊個影子」（9 局全部一次答啱）；「數車仔」仲學緊，14 局入面 6 局一次答啱。

highlights.en: About 2 h 07 min of games and 14 h 45 min of videos; 16 h 32 min of visa earned. Page 6 has a question about video time.
highlights.zh: 遊戲大約 2 小時 7 分，睇片大約 14 小時 45 分，賺到簽證 16 小時 32 分。睇片時間第 6 頁有個問題想問你哋。

also_learning.en: Also still learning: "Empty parking bay" (6/9), "Find the same" (7/10)
also_learning.zh: 其他仲學緊：「空車位」（6/9）、「搵同一個」（7/10）

also_well.en: Also going well: "Who carries more" (11/12), "Tap & Count in English · Tap each one" (6/7), "Line Match · Straight road" (5/6), "Tap & Count · Tap each one" (5/6), "Shapes · Follow the arrows" (7/9)
also_well.zh: 其他都做得好：「邊架載多啲人」（11/12）、「一架一架數（英文）· 點一點」（6/7）、「連一連 · 沿路送」（5/6）、「一架一架數 · 點一點」（5/6）、「畫形狀 · 跟箭嘴」（7/9）

still_learning_split.zh: 答題 3 個、練習 2 個

top_split.zh: 答題 3 個、練習 2 個

because.en: "Find the other half" 10/11; "Who carries more" 11/12 (right first time / rounds).
because.zh: 「搵另一半」10/11；「邊架載多啲人」11/12（第一次答啱／局數）。

check.en: right first time on the new versions
check.zh: 新題目出咗之後嘅第一次答啱率

text.en: Add question variants: "Find the other half" and "Who carries more" always show the same question and are right over 90% of the time.
text.zh: 加題目變化：「搵另一半」、「邊架載多啲人」次次都係同一條題目，答啱九成以上，可能已經記住。

because.en: "Numbers & quantity" was the lowest quiz area two weeks running: 50% this week (guessing gives about 40%), 52% last week.
because.zh: 「數字・數量」連續兩個星期係最低嘅答題類別：今個星期 50%（亂估都有大約 40%），上星期 52%。

check.en: right first time in "Numbers & quantity" over two weeks
check.zh: 「數字・數量」嘅第一次答啱率（兩個星期）

text.en: Add another "Numbers & quantity" game: numeral ↔ quantity matching, or "Which one is 3?"
text.zh: 多做一款「數字・數量」遊戲：數字 ↔ 數量配對，或者「邊個係 3？」

because.en: "Tap & Count · Count, then trace" smooth in 3 of 7, needed about 1.6 hints per numeral.
because.zh: 「一架一架數 · 數完畫」7 局入面 3 局做得順，描數字平均每次要提示 1.6 次。

check.zh: 每次要幾多提示、識咗幾多個數字

text.en: More tracing help: set "Tracing help" from Standard to More.
text.zh: 描數字提示加多：「描數字提示」由「標準」改做「多啲」。

because.en: "Line Match · Bridge road" smooth in 2 of 5, off the road 2.4 times per road.
because.zh: 「連一連 · 沿路過橋」5 局入面 2 局做得順，平均每條路出界 2.4 次。

check.en: road matching smooth rate; times off the road per road
check.zh: 沿路連線做得順嘅比例、每條路出界幾多次

text.en: Keep "Bridge road" at ★ only for now and let "Straight road" lead; tolerance is already Wide.
text.zh: 「沿路過橋」暫時只開 ★，等「沿路送」做得順先加返；寬容度已經係「闊」，唔使再改。

because.en: "Count the vehicles" 6 of 14 right first time; "Which lot has more" 6 of 10 right first time.
because.zh: 「數車仔」14 局入面 6 局一次答啱；「邊邊車多啲」10 局入面 6 局一次答啱。

text.en: Count things together: buses outside, bowls at dinner. Touch each one, then say how many altogether.
text.zh: 一齊數嘢：落街數巴士、食飯數碗筷，每數一樣用手指點一下，最後講「總共幾多個」。

because.en: "Tap & Count · Count, then trace" needed about 1.6 hints per numeral.
because.zh: 「一架一架數 · 數完畫」描數字平均每次要提示 1.6 次。

text.en: Write numbers together on a whiteboard or in sand, saying the rhyme; start with 3 and 5, already learned.
text.zh: 喺白板或者沙度一齊寫數字，邊寫邊講口訣；由佢已經識嘅 3 同 5 開始。

because.en: "Line Match · Bridge road" smooth in 2 of 5, off the road 2.4 times per road.
because.zh: 「連一連 · 沿路過橋」5 局入面 2 局做得順，平均每條路出界 2.4 次。

text.en: With a fat crayon on big paper, draw straight and curvy roads from a green dot to a red dot, slowly.
text.zh: 用粗蠟筆喺大張紙畫直線同彎路，由綠點開始畫到紅點，慢慢跟住條路行。

praise.en: When something goes well, praise the effort: "You looked at the shadow so carefully!" rather than "you're clever".
praise.zh: 見到佢做得好，讚佢做嘅過程：「你好細心咁睇影子！」，唔使講「你好聰明」。

note.en: The app only knows how long videos played, not whether anyone was watching.
note.zh: App 只知道片播咗幾耐，唔知道有冇人睇住。

question.en: On days with play, videos ran about 2 h 28 min a day (about 13 min per pick). Is that what you expect? Is the TV sometimes left playing with nobody watching?
question.zh: 今個星期有玩嘅日子平均每日睇片大約 2 小時 28 分（每次揀片之後平均播 13 分鐘）。呢個係咪你哋預期？有冇時候電視自己播緊、冇人睇住？
